label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 225
text:
§ 225



 There are, however, as has just been stated, certainly a few
          emotional diseases which have not merely been developed into that form out of corporeal
          diseases, but which, in an inverse manner, the body being but slightly indisposed,
          originate and are kept up by emotional causes, such as continued anxiety, worry, vexation,
          wrongs and the frequent occurrence of great fear and fright. This kind of emotional
          diseases in time destroys the corporeal health, often to a great degree.
